what: Plan instructs "parse STDERR_TAIL_PATH= from $lint_out when terminal failure" but $lint_out is deleted unconditionally at line 244 before any failure-status check occurs
scenario_or_breakage: An implementer placing the parse inside the case arm at line 245+ (after the rm -f) operates on a deleted file; awk returns empty; STDERR_TAIL_PATH is lost; tail silently never surfaces to chat for the step5 path
suggested_fix: The plan should explicitly state: save STDERR_TAIL_PATH= to a local variable by parsing $lint_out BEFORE line 244's rm -f, e.g. add a line between step5_parse_lint_capture_file and rm -f; then use the saved variable in the failure case arm.
